name: AidBadge – Country Support Stickers
author: NexGrowix

sections.description:
AidBadge – Country Support Stickers lets website owners display support stickers or badges for different countries, causes, or solidarity messages on their WordPress site. After installation, you can choose a sticker from the built-in collection and select an optional animation. The selected sticker is then shown on the front page of the website.

Use cases include showing support or solidarity for a country, a humanitarian cause, or an awareness campaign. The output is responsive and the settings screen does not require any coding.

Features:

  • A set of built-in support stickers and badges to choose from
  • Optional animation for the displayed sticker (floating, pulse, shake, spin on hover, or none)
  • Responsive output for desktop and mobile
  • Settings screen with no coding required
  • Lightweight assets loaded only on the front page
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress Plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu in WordPress.
  3. Go to the AidBadge menu to choose a sticker.
  4. Optionally select an animation for the sticker.
  5. Save the settings. The selected sticker will be displayed on the front page of your website.
sections.faq:
Can I upload my own sticker or banner?

Custom uploads are not supported in this version.

Can I choose multiple causes?

In this version, one sticker can be selected at a time.

Will it slow down my website?

Assets are loaded only on the front page, so the impact on other pages is minimal.
